title: Landing page loads
intent: As a first-time visitor I open the app and should see a working landing page that explains what the product does.
expected_observations: Page title is non-empty and names the product
A primary headline / value proposition is visible
A primary call-to-action button is visible (e.g. Sign up / Get started)
A way to log in is visible in the header

title: Login form is reachable and renders fields
intent: I want to log in, so I look for and open the login screen.
expected_observations: A login entry point is discoverable from the landing page
After clicking it, an email/username field and a password field are visible
A submit button is visible

title: Mobile viewport — landing is responsive
intent: I open the app on a phone (iPhone 13).
expected_observations: No horizontal scroll (content fits the viewport width)
A navigation affordance is available (hamburger / menu)
The primary call-to-action is still visible and tappable

title: User can log in and reach their home/dashboard
intent: I log in with my account and expect to land on my dashboard / home.
expected_observations: Login succeeds (URL is no longer the login screen)
The header shows a logged-in state (avatar / account menu / my email)
A personalised area (dashboard / home) with my content is visible

title: User can open their profile / account settings
intent: I want to view and edit my profile/account settings.
expected_observations: A profile / account / settings entry is discoverable from the logged-in UI
The profile page shows my account details
At least one editable field or a Save/Edit control is present

title: User completes the product's core action
intent: I perform the main thing this product is for (create/submit/buy/book/etc. — discover it from the UI).
expected_observations: The primary action is discoverable from the main UI
Starting it opens a form/flow with the expected inputs
On completion a clear success state / confirmation is shown

title: User can log out
intent: I log out of my account.
expected_observations: A logout control is discoverable from the account menu
After logout the UI returns to a logged-out state (login/sign-up CTA visible again)

title: Admin reaches the admin dashboard
intent: As an administrator I open the admin area and expect an overview.
expected_observations: An admin entry point is visible for this role
The admin dashboard renders with navigation to management sections
Some summary metrics or a list of manageable entities is visible

title: Admin opens a management list and a detail view
intent: I open a primary management section (users / items / orders), then open one record's detail.
expected_observations: A management list is reachable from the admin navigation
The list shows rows with identifying columns
Clicking a row / its action opens a detail or edit view for that record

title: Wrong password shows a clear error
intent: I enter a valid-looking email and a wrong password.
expected_observations: After submit, an error message is shown
The message is human-readable and in the app's UI language (not a raw backend code)
I am NOT logged in (still on the login screen)

title: Anonymous visitor cannot reach an admin-only area
intent: Without logging in, I try to reach an admin/privileged area by discovering any link to it.
expected_observations: There is no usable path into the admin area while logged out
If a privileged URL is hit, the app blocks it (redirect to login / not-authorized state) rather than exposing data

title: Restricted user is correctly gated from a privileged action
intent: As a limited/pending/blocked user I try to perform an action my state should not allow.
expected_observations: The blocked action is either hidden or visibly disabled for this user
If attempted, a clear explanation of why it's unavailable is shown
The action does not actually go through
